steps.title: Define App Metadata & Namespace
steps.description: Establish the application name 'Randomizer Pro' and target dynamic package 'com.randomizerpro.app' to be used across manifest, gradle configurations, and source classes.

steps.title: Configure Application Level Gradle Script
steps.description: Establish proper Android SDK 34 targets, Java 8 compatibility configurations, application ID matching, and clean compiler variables.

steps.title: Define Native Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure permissions, application theme standard, single main entry activity, application label, and local custom application icon reference.

steps.title: Establish Top Horizontal Navigation Layout
steps.description: Incorporate custom styling for simulated dynamic tab controls to allow seamless navigation between individual random utility features.

steps.title: Design Coin & Dice Layout Module
steps.description: Create dual interactive interactive coin flipping card and dice shaking structures featuring custom graphics and sizes.

steps.title: Design Custom Decision Maker Layout
steps.description: Construct dynamic option list container fields with direct entry controls and immediate option list visualizations.

steps.title: Design Random Number Generator UI
steps.description: Establish precise mathematical criteria controls including limit fields, duplicate options, and scrolling result boards.

steps.title: Design Password Generator Criteria Panels
steps.description: Assemble length slider adjustments, toggles for character sets, output monospaced views, and quick copy triggers.

steps.title: Initialize Main Activity Framework
steps.description: Map system-level controls, establish window parameters, and hook up base resource declarations.

steps.title: Implement Custom Tab Engine Visibility Controllers
steps.description: Write visibility management routines that handle swapping display frames and active button colors dynamically.

steps.title: Integrate Native Scale Coin Flip Animation API
steps.description: Code custom scaling rotation matrix animations to mimic actual 3D coin rotational mechanics with dynamic UI text toggles.

steps.title: Code Dice Shake Simulation Logic
steps.description: Produce translational displacement vectors to trigger visual shaking, random index math, and translation into rich Unicode character outputs.

steps.title: Implement Decision Option List Controllers
steps.description: Establish flexible vertical layout appenders that support dynamic row adding, user deletion tags, and verification check modules.

steps.title: Code Visual Decision Making Delay Generator
steps.description: Incorporate automated timed intervals to highlight selected dynamic list rows sequentially before isolating the chosen choice.

steps.title: Develop Advanced Random Number Distribution Logic
steps.description: Incorporate mathematical validations, random non-repeating sublists, custom format displays, and persistent roll history logs.

steps.title: Develop Secure Password Character Pool Generator
steps.description: Code precise characters arrays selection loops based on UI checkboxes to guarantee strong customized passcodes.

steps.title: Integrate Platform Clipboard System hooks
steps.description: Configure SDK clipboard operations to export generated passwords securely with customized success message notifications.

steps.title: Validate Resource References and Name Schemas
steps.description: Perform rigorous validation on Android standard attributes, layout hierarchies, state bounds, and memory references.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Level Compliance
steps.description: Confirm source is compile-safe under older standards without lambdas or target-mismatching methods.

steps.title: Building Randomizer Pro
steps.description: Execute native target assembly to create, build, sign, and packetize the production-ready application build.
